name: Potato
description: A staple root vegetable, firm and starchy, suited to boiling, frying, and long storage.

name: Tomato
description: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes with a good balance of acidity and sweetness, ideal for gravies and salads.

name: Bitter Gourd
description: A ridged green gourd with a distinctive bitter edge, commonly stir-fried or stuffed.

name: Pumpkin
description: Sweet, orange-fleshed pumpkin sold whole or by the piece, used in curries and lentil dishes.
